vatAccounts.title: VAT settings
vatAccounts.registeredRoleNote: Changing the VAT registration requires accountant rights.
vatAccounts.notRegisteredNote: The company is not VAT-registered, so entry lines can't be given a VAT rate and the VAT accounts are not used.
vatAccounts.hint: The VAT of an entry line is posted automatically as a row of its own on these accounts: VAT on a debit line to the receivable account, VAT on a credit line to the payable account.
vatAccounts.readOnlyNote: You have read-only access. Changing the VAT accounts requires ledger rights.

accountEdit.title: Edit account
accountEdit.numberHint: The account number can't be changed yet.
accountEdit.name: Account name
accountEdit.defaultVatHint: An entry line gets this VAT rate when the account is picked for it.
accountEdit.defaultVatNotRegistered: The company is not VAT-registered, so the default is not used on entry lines.

accountGroupEdit.name: Group name
accountGroupEdit.subItemHint: The sub-item of the income statement layout the group's accounts are shown under.
accountGroupEdit.balanceSheetItemHint: The item of the balance sheet layout the group's accounts are shown under.

costCenters.title: Cost centers
costCenters.readOnlyNote: You have read-only access. Managing cost centers requires ledger rights.

companyInfo.title: Company info
companyInfo.name: Company name
companyInfo.businessIdHint: The business ID can't be changed.
companyInfo.readOnlyNote: You have read-only access. Changing the company's details requires company administrator rights.

accounts.title: Bank accounts
accounts.readOnlyNote: You have read-only access. Managing bank accounts requires ledger rights.
accounts.confirmDeactivate: Remove bank account {{name}} from use? It can be taken back into use later.

dialog.name: Name
dialog.accountHint: The account the bank account's transactions are booked on. The accounts of the balance sheet item Cash in hand and at banks can be picked.
dialog.noAccounts: No accounts under the balance sheet item Cash in hand and at banks.

usersSettings.title: Users and roles
usersSettings.readOnlyNote: You have read-only access. Adding and removing users requires company administrator rights, changing roles at least accountant rights.
usersSettings.rolesOnlyNote: You can change the roles of users whose role is below your own. Adding and removing users requires company administrator rights.
usersSettings.confirmRemove: Remove {{name}}'s access to {{company}}? The entries they have made are kept.
usersSettings.newPasswordLabel: Create a new temporary password for {{name}}
usersSettings.confirmNewPassword: Create a new temporary password for {{name}}? The earlier one stops working.

createDialog.title: New user
createDialog.isAdminHint: An administrator can add and remove users, change everyone's roles and edit the company's details.
createDialog.existingHint: If the email address already has an account, the person is not added directly but sent an invitation, which they accept or decline themselves. Their name stays as it is.

credentials.title: Temporary password
credentials.intro: Give these credentials to the user. The password is shown only this once, and the user has to change it the first time they log in.
credentials.invitedBody: The email address {{email}} already has an account, so the person was sent an invitation. They find it in their inbox and get access to the company once they accept it.

invitations.title: Pending invitations
invitations.note: An invited person gets access to the company only after accepting the invitation.

invitation.title: Invitation to {{company}}
invitation.body: You have been invited to join this company. Role: {{role}}.
invitation.bodyAdmin: You have been invited to join this company as one of its administrators. Role: {{role}}.

generalLedger.title: General ledger
generalLedger.empty: No postings in the selected period.

incomeStatement.title: Income statement
incomeStatement.noPeriod: Choose a period. The company has no fiscal years yet.
incomeStatement.invalidPeriod: The start date can't be after the end date.

warnings.unclassified: These accounts have postings but belong to no account group, so they could not be placed on the income statement: {{accounts}}. If they are income or expense accounts, add them to a group in the chart of accounts.
warnings.unallocated: Some accounts are not allocated to a sub-item of the income statement layout ({{items}}). Their amounts are included in the item total. Set a sub-item for the account group in the chart of accounts.

balanceSheet.title: Balance sheet
balanceSheet.unallocated: Not allocated to a balance sheet item

warnings.unclassified: These accounts have postings but belong to no account group, so they could not be placed on the balance sheet: {{accounts}}. Assets and equity and liabilities therefore differ by {{difference}}. Add the accounts to a group in the chart of accounts.
warnings.unbalanced: Assets and equity and liabilities differ by {{difference}}.
warnings.unallocated: Some accounts are not allocated to an item of the balance sheet layout ({{items}}). Their amounts are included in the section total. Set a balance sheet item for the account group in the chart of accounts.

vat.rowsTitle: VAT rows added to the entry automatically.
vat.grossHint: The VAT is taken out of the line amount, and the line is stored net.
vat.accountMissing: The VAT account is not set, so a line with VAT can't be saved. Set the VAT accounts in the company settings.
vat.notRegistered: The company is not VAT-registered, so entry lines can't be given a VAT rate.

bankStatements.title: Bank statements
bankStatements.readOnlyNote: You have read-only access. Importing and booking bank statements requires the ledger clerk role.
bankStatements.selectHint: Pick a statement from the list to book its transactions here.
bankStatements.discardConfirm: The entry is unfinished. Discard it?

entries.title: Entries
entries.empty: No entries have been booked from this statement yet.
entries.confirmDelete: Delete entry {{voucher}}? This cannot be undone.

summary.title: Booked from the statement in total
summary.noBankAccount: Choose a bank account to have its deposits and withdrawals summed.

changePassword.title: Set your own password
changePassword.intro: Your account was created with a temporary password. Set a password of your own to continue.

dashboard.connected: Connected — server confirms access to company {{companyId}}.

subscription.title: Subscription required
subscription.statusNote: does not have an active subscription (status: {{status}}).
subscription.body: To start using the app for this company, its subscription must be paid. Online payment is coming soon — until then, please contact support to activate the subscription.

noCompany.title: No company
noCompany.choose: No company is selected. Choose a company from the top bar. If the one you were working in isn't listed, your access to it has been removed.
noCompany.notMember: You don't belong to any company.
noCompany.askForAccess: If you should have access to a company's books, ask that company's administrator to invite you with the email address {{email}}. The invitation will appear in the inbox in the top bar.
noCompany.pendingInvitations_one: You have an invitation to a company. Open the inbox in the top bar to answer it.
noCompany.pendingInvitations_other: You have {{count}} invitations. Open the inbox in the top bar to answer them.
noCompany.registerQuestion: Do you want to register a new company?

companyCreate.title: Register a new company
companyCreate.note: You become the company's administrator. Its books can be used once its subscription has been paid.

fiscalYears.title: Fiscal years
fiscalYears.readOnlyNote: You have read-only access. Managing fiscal years requires accountant rights.

hints.closeYearBlocked: Close all accounting periods before closing the fiscal year.

fiscalYears.confirmDelete: Delete fiscal year {{range}}? This cannot be undone.
